values: Published three-month ONI values rounded to 0.1 °C. Central month labels.
baseline: NOAA centered 30-year base periods updated every five years
processing: Select rows 1996–1999 from NOAA HTML table, preserve published values. No detrending or smoothing beyond the source ONI.
uncertainty: Source table does not publish a confidence interval for each ONI value.
